The '''Mid Rim Territories''', also known as the '''Middle Rim''', or as the '''Mid Rim''', was a region of [[the galaxy]] located between the [[Expansion Region]] and the [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TFAVD" /> The [[moon]] [[Wasskah]]<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> and the [[planet]]s [[Aleen]],<ref name="Aleen">{{SWE|locations|aleen|Aleen}}</ref> [[Bothawui]],<ref name="TFAVD" /> [[Coyerti]],<ref name="Twilight Company" /> [[Crul]],<ref name="Aliens" /> [[Dinzo]],<ref name="TWC">{{RebelsMagCite|30|The Wrong Crowd}}</ref> [[Gan Moradir]],<ref name="Aftermath">[[Aftermath (novel)|''Aftermath'']]</ref> [[Haidoral Prime]],<ref name="Twilight Company" /> [[Ithor]],<ref name="TFAVD" /> [[Kashyyyk]],<ref name="Wookiee Report">{{HoloNetNewsTumblr|post/92683360686/holonet-news-report-wookiee-revolt-quelled-on|Report: Wookiee Revolt Quelled on Kashyyyk|int=HoloNet News Report: Wookiee Revolt Quelled on Kashyyyk}}</ref> [[Malastare]],<ref name="Malastare">{{Databank|malastare|Malastare}}</ref> [[Naator]],<ref name="Twilight Company" /> [[NaJedha]],<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> [[Phorsa Gedd]],<ref name="Twilight Company" /> [[Shu-Torun]],<ref name="Vader Annual 1">[[Darth Vader Annual 1|''Darth Vader Annual'' 1]]</ref> [[Takodana]],<ref name="TFAVD" /> [[Naboo]], and [[Trandosha]] were all located within the Mid Rim.<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" />

After being allowed access to key Mid Rim [[Hyperspace route|trade routes]] through the [[Hutt–Republic treaty|Hutt Clan–Republic treaty]] during the [[Clone Wars]],<ref name="HL 3">[[Halcyon Legacy 3|''Halcyon Legacy'' 3]]</ref> the [[Hutt]]s had come to control part of the Mid Rim, by the [[time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War]] though, most was the territory of the Galactic Empire.<ref name="Rebel Files" />

==Description==
The Mid Rim was a region of [[the galaxy]] that formed a ring between the [[Expansion Region]] and the [[Outer Rim Territories]], making it the furthest region from the [[Deep Core]] that was considered part of the "inner [[planet]]s." The Mid Rim was full of varied worlds, many of which boasted successful governments and thriving economies; however, their distance from the Core meant that they lacked the fame or notoriety of [[Core Worlds]] like [[Corellia]].<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Parts of the Mid Rim overlapped with the [[Western Reaches]].<ref name="TFAVD">''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==History==
===Early history===
[[File:Maz_Kanatas_castle.png|thumb|left|300px|Maz Kanata's castle on Takodana]]
A thousand [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Cold War]],<ref name="Helmet Collection 52">{{HelmetCollectionCite|52|Databank A-Z}}</ref> a [[Battle of Takodana (Jedi versus Sith)|battle]] was fought on the Mid Rim [[Planet|world]] of [[Takodana]] between the ancient [[Jedi]] and [[Sith]]. [[Maz Kanata]]'s [[Takodana Castle|castle]] was later built on the site of the battlefield.<ref name="TFAVD" /> Jedha was a [[moon]] in the Mid Rim holy to many [[the Force|Force]] [[religion]]s. Sacred sites such as the [[Temple of the Kyber]] existed on the moon.<ref name="Ven Path">''[[The High Republic: Path of Vengeance]]''</ref>

===High Republic Era===
{{Quote|Do you know what they're talking about, Marda? What is the topic of every conversation from here to the Mid Rim? They're talking about Jedha.|[[Sheriff]] [[Jinx Pickwick]], to [[Guide of the Closed Fist|Path Guide]] [[Marda Ro]]|<ref name="Ven Path">''[[The High Republic: Path of Vengeance]]''</ref>}}
In [[382 BBY]],<ref name="Ven Death">''[[Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia]]'' dates the events of ''[[The High Republic: Path of Vengeance]]'' to [[382 BBY]].</ref> the [[Path of the Open Hand]] cult took advantage of the religious tensions of Jedha and fanned its flames into a massive riot.<ref name="Ven Path" /> At the same time, a [[summit on Jedha]] occurred<ref name="Battle of Jedha">''[[The High Republic: The Battle of Jedha]]''</ref> due to its status as neutral ground in the [[Eiram and E'ronoh War]].<ref name="Convergence">''[[The High Republic: Convergence]]''</ref> Due to Path interference, however, the peace talks broke down and reignited the conflict, which resumed there on Jedha<ref name="Battle of Jedha" /> and only worsened the violence started by the riots. The Path used the chaos as a cover to try and steal the [[Rod of Daybreak]]. While the [[Battle of Jedha]] would eventually cease and the peoples of Jedha began to work together on rebuilding their home in an uneasy peace, word of the incident and the Path's apparent involvement—quickly blamed on [[Herald (title)|Herald]] [[Werth Plouth]] alone by the equally-guilty [[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Elecia Zeveron]]—spread out from the Mid Rim.<ref name="Ven Path" />

===Malastare Narrows===
At some point before the [[Clone Wars]], the [[Corporate Alliance]] led by the [[Harch]] [[Admiral]] [[Trench]] [[blockade]]d the Mid Rim world of [[Malastare]]. A [[Galactic Republic]] force consisting of [[Wullf Yularen]] and a Jedi-led task force put an end to the blockade, which resulted in heavy losses for both sides as well as the Harch [[commander]]'s first presumed [[death]].<ref name="Cat and Mouse">{{TCW|Cat and Mouse}}</ref>

===Naboo Crisis===
In [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Episode I date">{{FilmDate|I}}</ref> the [[Trade Federation]] and the Republic were embroiled in a dispute over the taxation of [[Hyperspace route|trade routes]] to outlying [[Star system|systems]] including the Mid Rim world of [[Naboo]]. As a result, the Trade Federation [[Invasion of Naboo|invaded and occupied]] the planet. The Federation was eventually [[Battle of Naboo|expelled]] from the planet by a coalition of the [[human]] [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]], the indigenous [[Gungan]]s, and the Jedi.<ref name="Episode I">{{Film|I}}</ref>

===The Clone Wars===
Until the Clone Wars, the Mid Rim was considered a tranquil region,<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> but it saw extensive fighting between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the conflict.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid">{{TCW|Downfall of a Droid}}</ref> The [[Hutt–Republic treaty|treaty]] established between the Republic and [[Hutt Clan]] in the aftermath of the [[Mission to Jabba's Palace (Clone Wars)|mission to Jabba's Palace]]<ref name="TCWFilm">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> gave the Hutts access to important trade routes that ran through the Mid Rim. During a [[Skirmish on the Halcyon|skirmish]] aboard the [[MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruiser|MPO-1400 ''Purgill''-class star cruiser]] ''[[Halcyon]]'', [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] convinced a [[Lord]] [[Unidentified Hutt (Halcyon)|Hutt]] on the ship to help [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and her by noting the Republic had the power to revoke the Hutt access to those key routes.<ref name="HL 3" />

[[File:DauntlessPioneer-DoaD.png|thumb|right|300px|In 22 BBY, the Republic Navy was deployed to Bothawui to arrest the Separatist advance into the Mid Rim.]]
After [[General]] [[Grievous]] [[Battle of Falleen|ambushed]] [[Republic Navy]] [[Republic Military|forces]] above the planet [[Falleen (planet)|Falleen]], Jedi General [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] advised Skywalker to take his [[fleet]] out of [[Bothawui]] to regroup. Skywalker's fleet instead [[Battle of Bothawui|clashed]] with Grievous' fleet above Bothawui<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" /> in [[22 BBY]].<ref name="Bothawui Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates [[Battle of Bothawui]] to [[22 BBY]].</ref> During the battle, [[R2-D2]] was lost but was later rescued.<ref name="Duel of the Droids">{{TCW|Duel of the Droids}}</ref> The defense of Bothawui protected the Republic's grip over the Mid Rim, which the Confederacy had nearly finished establishing its own foothold within.<ref name="Battles">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''</ref>

Later, Amidala, [[Junior Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks]], the Jedi, and [[clone trooper]]s discovered that the Separatist [[scientist]] [[Nuvo Vindi]] was operating a [[Trade Federation laboratory|biological weapons laboratory]] on Naboo.<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref> Following a lengthy [[Raid on Nuvo Vindi's laboratory|struggle]], they neutralized [[Doctor|Dr.]] Vindi's [[Blue Shadow Virus]] and prevented it from escaping into Naboo's atmosphere.<ref name="Mystery of a Thousand Moons">{{TCW|Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref>

In [[21 BBY]],<ref name=" Malastare Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates [[Battle of Malastare]] to [[21 BBY]].</ref> Malastare became the site of [[Battle of Malastare|fighting]] between the Republic and the Separatists due to its [[fuel]] supplies. During the battle, the Jedi signed a [[Treaty of Malastare|treaty]] with the [[Dug Council]] after agreeing to destroy an ancient monster called the [[Zillo Beast]]. The Jedi and clone [[trooper]]s managed to [[stun]] the beast with [[cannon]]s and smuggled it back to [[Coruscant]] for research.<ref name="The Zillo Beast">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast}}</ref>

[[File:MalastareFuelLines-TZB.png|thumb|left|300px|Malastare's fuel reserves were vital to the Republic war effort.]]
In [[20 BBY]],<ref name="Wasskah Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates [[Battle on Wasskah]] to [[20 BBY]].</ref> the Jedi [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] was kidnapped by [[Trandoshan]] [[bounty hunter]]s and transported to the [[Trandosha]]n [[moon]] of [[Wasskah]]. There, she teamed up with the former [[Jedi Initiate|Jedi younglings]] [[Kalifa]], [[O-Mer]], and [[Jinx]] to survive.<ref name="Padawan Lost">{{TCW|Padawan Lost}}</ref> The Jedi then joined forces with the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] to [[Battle on Wasskah|fight back]] against the Trandoshans. They were rescued by a Wookiee relief force led by General [[Tarfful]].<ref name="Wookiee Hunt">{{TCW|Wookiee Hunt}}</ref>

Later that year,<ref name="Naboo Date">{{TCWcanondates|404}}</ref> the Gungan [[minister]] [[Rish Loo]], a Separatist [[agent]], attempted to manipulate [[Boss]] [[Lyonie]] into helping the Separatists attack the Naboo [[capital]] [[Theed]]. Loo's plot was foiled by Binks, Amidala, and [[Jedi Knight]] Skywalker. The Gungans [[Skirmish on Naboo|captured]] Grievous but were forced to release him after the [[Head of State|Separatist leader]] [[Count]] [[Dooku]] took Skywalker hostage.<ref name="Shadow Warrior">{{TCW|Shadow Warrior}}</ref>

Later, the Mid Rim planet of [[Aleen]] experienced severe [[Groundquake|earthquakes]], which killed many of the native [[Aleena]]. With forces from the [[104th Battalion]] redirected to Aleen instead of the [[Annexation of the Qiilura system|defense]] of the [[Qiilura system]], the [[droid]]s [[C-3PO]] and R2-D2 took part in a Republic relief mission led by [[Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe]]. During the course of the [[Mission to Aleen|mission]], C-3PO and R2-D2 encountered the underground-dwelling [[Kintaro]] and the [[amphibian]] being [[Orphne]], who revealed that the earthquakes had been caused by a breach on the surface. After returning to Aleen's surface, the two droids helped seal the breach, which ended the earthquake and restored peace to both the underworld and surface.<ref name="Mercy Mission">{{TCW|Mercy Mission (episode)}}</ref> C-3PO and R2-D2 then embarked on an unplanned adventure which took them to the planets [[Patitite Pattuna]] and [[Balnab]].<ref name="Nomad Droids">{{TCW|Nomad Droids}}</ref>

[[File:Tear-Them-Apart.png|thumb|right|250px|Shadow Collective forces tear through a deactivated droid army on Ord Mantell in 19 BBY.]]
Some time after, Kenobi, Skywalker, and [[Mace Windu]] foiled a plot by [[Cad Bane]] and Count Dooku to [[Plan to kidnap Chancellor Palpatine|kidnap]] [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]], secretly known as Darth Sidious.<ref name="Crisis on Naboo">{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref> In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="DarthMaul2 date">{{TCWcanondates|SOD2}}</ref> the planet [[Ord Mantell]] was the site of a [[Battle on Ord Mantell|battle]] between the former [[Sith apprentice]] [[Maul]] and his [[Shadow Collective]] and Grievous, which ended in the latter's capture.<ref name="Darth Maul 2">[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 2|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 2]]</ref> In response, the Republic sent a team of Jedi led by Windu to Ord Mantell to investigate Maul's activities.<ref name="Darth Maul 3">[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 3|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 3]]</ref>

During the [[Outer Rim Sieges]], the Jedi General [[Quinlan Vos]] moved his forces to [[Boz Pity]]. Master [[Yoda]] commanded Wookiee and clone forces during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk]]. Yoda was forced to flee the Wookiee [[homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk]] when Sidious issued [[Order 66]]. Shortly thereafter, the Republic was [[Proclamation of the New Order|transformed]] into the [[Galactic Empire]] and the [[Executive Separatist Council|Separatist leadership]] was [[Mission to Mustafar|destroyed]], ending the Clone Wars.<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref>

===Imperial Era===
During the [[Imperial Era]], the Mid Rim along with much of [[the galaxy]] came under the dominion of the Empire.<ref name="Tarkin" /> At one point, a series of chaotic [[Mid Rim uprisings]] were launched against the Empire by rebelling monarchies, but the revolt was put down by [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot]]s.<ref name="Squadrons">''[[Star Wars: Squadrons]]''</ref> In [[14 BBY]],<ref name="Tarkin date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']] to [[14 BBY]].</ref> the Imperial [[Vice Admiral]] [[Dodd Rancit]] identified the Mid Rim world of [[Lantillies]] as a potential target of [[Berch Teller]]'s [[Berch Teller's rebel cell|rebel cell]].<ref name="Tarkin" />

In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Vandor Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the [[Heist on Vandor]] to [[10 BBY]].</ref> the criminal [[Tobias Beckett]] and [[Beckett's gang|his gang]] including Imperial deserter [[Han Solo]] and Chewbacca undertook a [[Heist on Vandor|heist]] to steal a train cargo of [[coaxium]]<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> on the Mid Rim world of [[Vandor]].<ref name="Solo Official Guide">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]''</ref> The heist failed due to the intervention of [[Enfys Nest]] and her rebel group the [[Cloud-Riders]], leaving Beckett and his crew indebted to the [[Crimson Dawn]] [[crime lord]] [[Dryden Vos]]. After convincing Dryden to give them a second chance, Solo, Beckett, Chewbacca, and the Crimson Dawn [[lieutenant]] [[Qi'ra]] convinced the smuggler and gambler [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] to help them [[Raid on Kessel|steal]] coaxium from the [[Pyke Syndicate]] on [[Kessel]].<ref name="Solo" />

On one occasion, [[HoloNet News]] reported that the [[212th Attack Battalion]] led by General [[Kahdah]] had quelled a [[Wookiee revolt]] on Kashyyyk. As a result, civilian travel to the planet was restricted.<ref name="Wookiee Report" /> The [[Xenophobia|xenophobic]] Empire also [[Slavery|enslaved]] the Wookiees of Kashyyyk, viewing them as an expendable source of slave labor. Many Wookiees were fitted with [[Behavioral modification biochip|inhibitor chips]] while Kashyyyk was renamed Imperial Territory G5-623.<ref name="Life Debt">''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]''</ref> Nevertheless, some Wookiees like Chewbacca<ref name="Aftermath" /> and [[Lohgarra]] managed to flee offworld and live free lives.<ref name="Lost Stars">''[[Lost Stars]]''</ref>

In [[4 BBY]],<ref name="Wings Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Wings of the Master]]" to [[4 BBY]].</ref> the [[Spectres]] rebel operative [[Hera Syndulla]] traveled to the Mid Rim world of [[Shantipole]] on behalf of the rebellion to obtain a [[Prototype B6|prototype]] [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter|B-wing starfighter]] from the [[Mon Calamari]] [[engineer]] [[Quarrie]]. As a result, the rebellion gained access to the B-wing [[starfighter]]s.<ref name="Wings of the Master">{{Rebels|Wings of the Master}}</ref>

In [[3 BBY]],<ref name="Onoam Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Leia, Princess of Alderaan]]'' to [[3 BBY]].</ref> [[Saw Gerrera]]'s [[Partisans]] [[Strike on Onoam|assassinated]] Naboo's Imperial [[governor]], [[Moff]] [[Quarsh Panaka]].<ref name="Leia, Princess of Alderaan">''[[Leia, Princess of Alderaan]]''</ref>

[[File:Imperial_Hovertank_on_Jedha.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Imperial forces patrolling Jedha City]]
By [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Rogue One date">{{FilmDate|RO}}</ref> [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] had occupied Jedha. The Empire [[Mining|mined]] Jedha for [[kyber crystal]]s, which were used as part of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star's]] [[superlaser]]. [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] later [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] [[Jedha City]] in order to test the Death Star's superlaser. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] operatives [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] and [[Jyn Erso]] managed to smuggle the Imperial defector [[Bodhi Rook]], who had knowledge on how to destroy the Death Star, offworld. To conceal the Death Star, the Empire told the [[Imperial Senate]] that Jedha City had been destroyed in a mining accident. In addition, the Empire ran a [[Imperial Detention Center & Labor Camp LEG-817|penal labor camp]] on the planet [[Wobani]].<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

Following the [[Destruction of Alderaan|destruction]] of [[Alderaan]], Darth Vader [[Mission to Shu-Torun|visited]] the Mid Rim [[Volcano|volcanic]] mining world of [[Shu-Torun]] to ensure that the [[Unidentified King of Shu-Torun|King of Shu-Torun]] and his people remained loyal to the Empire. Vader defeated a plot by the [[King]] and his [[Kingdom of Shu-Torun|family]] to [[assassin]]ate him with the help of the [[assassin droid]]s [[0-0-0]] and [[BT-1]]. Vader then forced the King's youngest daughter [[Princess]] [[Trios]] to become the new [[Queen]] of Shu-Torun.<ref name="Vader Annual 1" /> Trios helped the Empire to subdue several rebellious [[ore-duke]]s during the [[Shu-Torun War|War on Shu-Torun]].<ref name="Shu-Torun War">''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader Book III: The Shu-Torun War]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War]], several Mid Rim worlds and systems including [[Haidoral Prime]], [[Coyerti]], the [[Chonsetta system]], the [[Redhurne system]], and the [[Elochar sector]] became battle sites between the Rebel Alliance and the Empire during the [[Mid Rim Retreat]]. After [[Standard month|months]] of fighting, [[Alliance Military|Alliance forces]] became overstretched and [[Alliance High Command]] was forced to order a retreat as Imperial forces counter-attacked.<ref name="Twilight Company" />

===Rise of the New Republic===
[[File:LeiaSorunaSharaLeaveTheedHangar-ShatteredEmpire3.png|thumb|right|200px|The Scouring of Naboo]]
After the [[Battle of Endor]], crowds celebrated the death of Darth Sidious in the streets of Naboo's capital Theed.<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref> Later, the Naboo [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Sosha Soruna]] accepted an offer from Princess [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] to join the [[New Republic]], the successor government to the Rebel Alliance. In the [[Standard day|days]] after the events at [[Endor]], Naboo was targeted by [[Operation: Cinder]], a [[contingency]] plan to scour several worlds in the event of the [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]]'s death. General Lando Calrissian [[Battle of Theed|saved]] the planet from being destroyed by several Imperial [[climate disruption array]]s.<ref name="Shattered Empire 3">[[Shattered Empire 3|''Shattered Empire'' 3]]</ref> The New Republic also repelled [[Invasions of Naboo|three attempts]] by Imperial forces to retake the planet.<ref name="Lost Stars" />

In the months following Endor, Grand Moff [[Valco Pandion]] abandoned an [[Malastare communications station|Imperial communications station]] on Malastare.<ref name="Aftermath" /> Despite this setback, Imperial [[Kenner Loring's faction|remnant forces]] under [[Grand General]] [[Kenner Loring]] still controlled the planet. During the Galactic Civil War, Maz Kanata's castle on Takodana was regarded as a neutral sanctuary for [[smuggler]]s, [[pirate]]s, Imperials, and rebels.<ref name="Life Debt" />

Solo and his co-[[pilot]] Chewbacca later led a campaign to [[Liberation of Kashyyyk|liberate]] Kashyyyk from Imperial rule.<ref name="Aftermath" /> Despite several setbacks and the New Republic's hesitance, Solo and Chewie managed to disable Grand Moff [[Lozen Tolruck]]'s inhibitor chips and inspire a Wookiee revolt in [[5 ABY]]<ref name="Empire's End date">''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]'' features the [[Battle of Jakku]], an event that ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[5 ABY]].</ref> with the help of Wookiee [[Exile (punishment)|exiles]], former slaves, the former Imperial [[loyalty officer]] [[Sinjir Rath Velus]], the bounty hunter [[Jas Emari]], and the [[New Republic Special Forces]] [[New Republic soldier|soldier]] [[Jom Barell]]. A [[New Republic Defense Fleet|New Republic fleet]] led by Admiral [[Gial Ackbar|Ackbar]] then forced the surrender of the remaining [[Imperial Navy|Imperial ships]] above Kashyyyk, ending the Imperial subjugation of the Wookiees.<ref name="Life Debt" /> In the months leading up to the [[Battle of Jakku]], Wookiee and [[New Republic Defense Force|New Republic forces]] mopped up Imperial holdouts, liberating many Wookiee slaves including [[Lumpawaroo|Waroo]], Chewbacca's son.<ref name="Empire's End">''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]''</ref>

The Mid Rim world of Naboo also became a refuge for many orphans and [[refugee]]s. One of these, [[Mapo]], befriended Binks, who had become a street performer.<ref name="Empire's End" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Around 9 Date">{{MandoDate|21}}</ref> the Mid Rim came under repeated attack by the [[Pirate Nation]], with the New Republic failing to defend the region.<ref name="Chapter 21">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 21: The Pirate}}</ref>

===Cold War===
[[File:ColossusRises-NoEscapePart2.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The ''Colossus'' would eventually depart the Mid Rim planet Castilon]]
Prior to the outbreak of [[First Order-Resistance War|open war]], the [[First Order]] used a series of false flag pirate raids on the ''[[Colossus]]'' oil refueling platform on the Mid Rim planet [[Castilon]] to pressure [[Captain]] [[Imanuel Doza]] into accepting a [[Occupation of the Colossus|military occupation]] of the ''Colossus''.<ref name="TFOO">{{Resistance|The First Order Occupation}}</ref> Following the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]], [[Team Colossus|Team ''Colossus'']]'','' led by Resistance [[spy]] [[Kazuda Xiono]] and New Republic veteran [[Jarek Yeager]] expelled the First Order and [[Battle of Castilon|took]] the [[space station]] into space.<ref name="No Escape 2">{{Resistance|No Escape: Part 2}}</ref> In response, the First Order launched a [[Hunt for the Colossus|hunt]] for the runaway station.<ref name="Into the Unknown">{{Resistance|Into the Unknown}}</ref>

In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Episode VII date">{{FilmDate|VII}}</ref> Maz Kanata's castle on Takodana was [[Battle of Takodana|attacked]] by the First Order. The Hosnian Cataclysm was also witnessed by many at Maz Kanata's castle.<ref name="Episode VII">{{Film|VII}}</ref>

===First Order/Resistance War===
[[File:KijimiCity-DB.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Mid Rim planet Kijimi was annihilated by the Sith Eternal]]
During the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the First Order and the Resistance, [[Poe Dameron]], [[Finn]], Chewbacca, and [[Klaud]] undertook a [[Mission to Sinta Glacier Colony|mission]] to the [[Sinta Glacier Colony]], where [[Boolio]] informed them that a [[Armitage Hux|First Order spy]] had confirmation that Darth Sidious had returned from the dead.<ref name="Episode IX">{{Film|IX}}</ref>

Later, [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], Finn, Poe, Chewbacca, C-3PO, [[BB-8]], and [[D-O]] traveled to [[Kijimi City]] seeking a [[droidsmith]] who could retrieve the memory of the inscriptions on [[Ochi]]'s [[Blade of Ochi of Bestoon|dagger]] from 3PO's [[memory bank]]s. The group found a droid mechanic named [[Babu Frik]], who got C-3PO to translate the [[Ur-Kittât|Sith inscription]] at the cost of losing his memories, a choice that 3PO willingly made to help his friends. With the help of Poe's former spice-running associate [[Zorii Bliss]], the group escaped offworld, rescued Chewie, and retrieved the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' from the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']].<ref name="Episode IX" /> In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Episode IX date">{{FilmDate|IX}}</ref> the resurrected Darth Sidious ordered [[Allegiant General]] [[Enric Pryde]] to send the [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Derriphan]]'' to destroy Kijimi in order to intimidate the galaxy into submitting to the Emperor's [[Sith Eternal]].<ref name="Episode IX" />
